topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: You know, I’ve been thinking a lot about what you said. Change, a fresh start, it's always hard but also exciting, right? The distance isn't going to change how much I care about you. We've been through so much, and I know we can handle this. I’m going to miss the days we just drop by each other's place or hang out at the park, but there's so much we can still do. We’ll find new ways to make it work. Maybe we can start a little tradition, like having a weekly call or a virtual book club. I’m here for you, no matter what, and I’m excited to see all the amazing things that are going to happen for you in this new place. Let’s make the most of it, okay?
